en: A vintage black and white postcard with four photographic panels. The top left shows a castle with towers and a river, labeled 'Schloß Wildeck.' The top right features a waterfall or weir labeled 'Bodemer-Wehr.' The bottom left depicts a river winding through a forested valley, captioned 'Blick ins Zschopautal.' The bottom right shows an aerial view of a town with the label 'Zschopau i. Sa.'
